title: Longest Common Prefix
description: Write a function to find the longest common prefix string amongst an array of strings. If there is no common prefix, return an empty string `""`.

hints.content: Start by assuming the first string is the common prefix.
Trim the prefix from the end while the next string does not start with it.

solution.explanation:
Horizontal scanning: compare prefix against each string, shortening the prefix until it matches.
Time Complexity: O(S) where S is sum of all characters in strings
Space Complexity: O(1)
